recommendation: Keep the source fix. It completes the FHIR-40296 move-to-extension application in the current core documentation without separately deciding FHIR-50581, which remains Resolved - change required.
issue_request: FHIR-40296 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested moving ElementDefinition obligation to an extension to allow continued iteration and tooling flexibility.
initial_application: The Jira-tagged commit fa3b0bac14 removed ElementDefinition.obligation from source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml, deleted the core obligation CodeSystem and ValueSet source files, and updated several related pages, but source/obligations.html still had two sentences describing obligation as an ElementDefinition feature/element.
additional_context: Current core source has ElementDefinition.mustSupport but no ElementDefinition.obligation, and the FHIR Extension Pack defines http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/obligation. FHIR-I minutes from 2023-02-06 support the persuasive decision. Later applied FHIR-50580 uses Obligation Extension wording, and later unresolved FHIR-50581 independently identified the same stale obligations-page phrases.
reconciliation: Updated source/obligations.html to describe mustSupport as the ElementDefinition property and obligation as the http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/obligation extension in both affected locations.
source_changes: source/obligations.html: replaced stale references to obligation as an ElementDefinition feature/element with references to the Obligation Extension.

related_jiras.note: Applied R6 clarification uses Obligation Extension wording and confirms the current page should not imply an obligation element.
Later R6 correction calls out the exact stale phrases fixed here, but it is not separately decided because its workflow status is Resolved - change required.

evidence_items.summary: The built obligations documentation still described obligation as an ElementDefinition feature/element before this commit.
evidence_items.learned: Those source lines contradicted the extension-based model and needed correction.

evidence_items.summary: The Extension Pack defines http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/obligation as an extension.
evidence_items.learned: The current obligation artifact is extension-pack content rather than an ElementDefinition child in core.

evidence_items.summary: FHIR-I minutes record the FHIR-40296 Persuasive 11-0-0 vote and discussion of whether the new extension would be core or tooling.
evidence_items.learned: Meeting evidence supports moving obligation to an extension and does not support retaining element wording.

evidence_items.summary: Later Resolved - change required correction says the obligations page should refer to the Obligation Extension instead of an obligation element.
evidence_items.learned: A later review independently confirms the stale FHIR-40296 wording, but the issue is not separately in Applied/Published scope.
